sources.citation: Lindfors, Anna-Lena, Mark Woodward & Louise Nagler. 2009. A sociolinguistic survey of the Nyiha and Nyika language communities in Tanzania, Zambia and Malawi. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2009-012. Dallas: SIL International. 145 pp.
sources.note: Nothing descriptive. Sociolinguistic survey with 241-item wordlists in broad IPA; p.18 sec.4.2.1: 'Tone was not noted.'; p.21 sec.4.2.2.2: 'In this count, stress, tone and length were disregarded, as the wordlist format was thought not to be adequate for comparing these features. During elicitation it was noted that these features sometimes varied from time to time and from speaker to speaker.' Identifies nkt as 'Nyiha of Sumbawanga (Western Nyika)', autonym aanjiha, Sandulula and Mollo wards, Sumbawanga Rural District.
